test_title: SSC CHSL 2025 Tier-1 (Held On: 18 Nov, 2025 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: Sonu and Monu together can do a piece of work in 30 days. If Sonu is 20% less efficient than Monu, in how many days can Sonu, working alone, complete 40% of the work?
solution:
**Given:**

Sonu + Monu time = 30

Sonu efficiency = 80% of Monu

Required work = 40%

**Formula Used:**

Efficiency ∝ 1 ÷ Time

Work = Efficiency × Time

;

**Calculation:**

⇒ Let Monu efficiency = 5x

⇒ Sonu efficiency = 4x

⇒ Combined efficiency = 9x

⇒ 9x = 1 ÷ 30

⇒ x = 1 ÷ 270

⇒ Sonu efficiency = 4x = 4 ÷ 270 = 2 ÷ 135

⇒ Time taken by Sonu for full work = 1 ÷ (2 ÷ 135) = 135 ÷ 2

⇒ Time for 40% work = 135 ÷ 2 × 40 ÷ 100

⇒ Time = 135 ÷ 2 × 2 ÷ 5

⇒ Time = 135 ÷ 5

⇒ Time = 27

**∴ The correct answer is 27.**
